newsitem.title: ITALY: Ciampi says Italy aims to cut debt service charges.
newsitem.headline: Ciampi says Italy aims to cut debt service charges.

text.p: Italian Treasury Minister Carlo Azeglio Ciampi said on Tuesday that the government intended to reduce the burden of state debt service charges to 8 pct of GDP by end-1998 from the 1996 target of 10.75 pct.

Ciampi, speaking in the Senate (upper house of parliament) during a debate on Italy's 1997 budget, also said there would be no "window-dressing" of Italy's end of year accounts and repeated a call to banks to bring down their lending rates.
